Here's how to fill in your parts of the form. I've left everything about your nephew, his parents and the first emergency contact blank for your sister, as you asked.

**Leave blank**
- **B01–B07:** These sit under "FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY", so the preschool fills them in.
- **B13–B29:** Your sister fills these in (the child, the family, the parents, who may collect him, and emergency contact 1).

**B08: I hereby make application for admission of .... to the .... Preschool/Daycare**
- First blank (child's name): leave it for your sister.
- Second blank (preschool name): NEEDS-YOU. The name of the preschool isn't in the form, so write it in by hand. Use the same name in the form's title line.

**B09: Name of Applicant**
GIVEN_P1 MIDDLE_P1 SURNAME_P1

**B10: Tel**
PHONE_P1
The form has three boxes: (C) cell, (W) work and (H) home. I don't know which kind your number is, so put it in the matching box and leave the other two empty. If it's a mobile, that's (C).

**B11: Email**
NEEDS-YOU. You didn't give me an email address. Write yours in by hand, or leave it blank if you'd rather not give one.

**B12: Relationship to child**
Aunt (maternal)
If the preschool is likely to want a reason, you could put "Aunt (maternal), applying on behalf of the mother".

**B30: Emergency contact 2**
- Name of Person: GIVEN_P1 SURNAME_P1
- Tel: PHONE_P1, in the same box you used in B10. Leave the other two empty.

**Things to check**
- Your address, date of birth and passport details aren't asked for anywhere in your sections, so I've left them out.
- The form has no signature line in the text I can see. If the paper copy has one for the applicant, you may need to sign as the applicant. Some preschools also want the parent's signature or a short note from your sister authorising you to apply. Ask the preschool which they need.
- B28 (people authorised to collect him) is your sister's to fill in. If she wants you to be able to pick him up, she should add your name there too.

I hope your sister feels better soon.
